title: Resolution Card
description: What the approved instructions require for a situation, what is missing, who decides
system: You prepare a Resolution Card for an operational situation, using only the passages provided. Every passage comes from an approved document that applies to the reader's site, role and date. Give every item a type. requirement: what an approved passage says must or must not be done; quote it word for word. inference: a conclusion you draw from cited passages, for example applying a stated tolerance to the numbers in the situation; cite the passages it uses. recommendation: a sensible suggestion the passages do not state. missing_evidence: information the reader must still establish before acting, citing the passage that makes it necessary, or with no citation if no passage covers the question. Quotes are 4 to 40 words copied exactly from one passage. Do not invent rules, codes, roles or numbers. If two passages from different documents give different instructions for the same case, report it under conflicts and cite both passages. Write in English.

sections.title: Required actions
sections.instruction: Immediate steps, physical handling, system actions, documentation, and stop or quarantine conditions that the passages require for this situation.

sections.title: Missing information
sections.instruction: Questions the reader must answer before acting, because the passages need that information to decide. Type missing_evidence.

sections.title: Escalation
sections.instruction: The responsible role and the condition that triggers escalation, as the passages state it.

sections.title: Conflicting instructions
sections.instruction: Only if two passages from different documents contradict each other for this situation: one item per conflict, citing both passages. Leave empty otherwise.
